thread:
maya: Heads-up — EU embed service is seeing intermittent 503s (~20% of requests) on the quant path. Need a hotfix deploy in the next 15m. Can we fast-track? Deploy slot limited so we'll likely need to skip the full canary.

deploybot: [automated] Detected spike: eu-west1 embed 5xxs rising. Recommend hotfix rollout. To approve, respond with 'proceed' and include rollback criteria.

sam: Proceed if rollback plan is spelled out and ops reserves surge slot. What are we pinning to?

maya: Pin target: v2.3.7-hotfix (sha: abc1234). Fix is kv-cache memory bounds clamp in inference worker (no DB/schema). Rollback plan: revert to v2.3.6 and route 100% traffic back; rollback window 10m after seeing >2% 5xx for 3 consecutive minutes.

alex: Confirming the root cause — OOM on quant path causing resp failures. Change looks minimal. I can watch tensors/kv metrics and test locally. ops-oncall, can you reserve surge slot?

ops-oncall: Reserving eu-west1 surge slot 23:45-00:15 UTC. I'll be on pager. If 5xxs >2% after 3m we trigger rollback.

deploybot: Command queued: `/deploy run hotfix-eu-embeds v2.3.7 --skip-canary --tag=expedite-1739123456`

nora: :+1: Security review done — no secret or ACL changes. Notify SOC if you change KMS.

olivia: I'll update the release notes / changelog now: "fix(eu-embeds): clamp kv-cache memory to avoid OOMs causing 503s — PR #842"

sam: Quick votes: maya ✅ alex ✅ nora ✅ ops-oncall ✅ olivia ✅ — proceed with expedited deploy.

maya: Launching the deploy now. pinging infra to keep an eye.

deploybot: [INFO] Starting expedited rollout to eu-west1 with tag expedite-1739123456. Instances targeted: pool-d-12 -> pool-d-14. Rolling strategy: parallel per AZ. Link: https://deploy.internal/release/expedite-1739123456

alex: Watching live metrics. CPU/kv-cache mem trending down, qps steady.

ops-oncall: Cutover window in place. If >2% 5xx persist after 3m, I will trigger rollback. Standby for handoff.

deploybot: [SUCCESS] Rollout reached 100% in eu-west1 after 6m. No sustained 5xx spike detected. Marking expedite-1739123456 as stable.

maya: Thanks all — closing thread. Release note pushed, doc updated, monitoring set. If anything crops up, reopen thread or page ops-oncall.
